title: Jesus Loves Me
lyrics_plain:
Jesus loves me!
this I know,
For the Bible tells me so;
Little ones to him belong;
They are weak, but he is strong.
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.
Jesus loves me!
he who died
Heaven's gates to open wide!
He will wash away my sin
Let his little child come in.
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.
Jesus loves me!
he will stay
Close beside me all the way;
If I love him,
when I die
He will take me home on high
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
Yes, Jesus loves me,
The Bible tells me so.
